evaluation_unit: question_id; macro-average over questions and report stratified slices by split, geography composition, persona, response type, and difficulty.

retrieval.name: Recall@k
retrieval.formula: For each question, count whether each gold essential source is retrieved in the first k; average the source-level indicator over essential sources and questions.
retrieval.interpretation: Measures coverage of essential sources; do not count contextual or negative judgments as required hits.

retrieval.name: Precision@k
retrieval.formula: Relevant retrieved items in top k divided by k, with graded gain reported separately for highly relevant/conditional/contextual items.
retrieval.interpretation: Report a strict essential/highly relevant view and a graded view.

retrieval.name: MRR
retrieval.formula: Mean reciprocal rank of the first essential or highly relevant source; zero when no acceptable source is retrieved.
retrieval.interpretation: Use the first acceptable source, not the first near miss.

retrieval.name: nDCG@k
retrieval.formula: Discounted cumulative gain using gains essential=3, highly_relevant=2, conditionally_relevant=1, contextual=0.5, normalized by ideal DCG for that question.
retrieval.interpretation: Preserves graded relevance and ranking position.

retrieval.name: Essential-source recall
retrieval.formula: Retrieved essential source count divided by gold essential source count, averaged by question.
retrieval.interpretation: Primary recall metric for single and bundle questions.

retrieval.name: Near-miss rejection
retrieval.formula: 1 minus the proportion of gold near_miss/irrelevant/prohibited items presented as recommended.
retrieval.interpretation: Evaluate recommendation state, not mere mention in an explanation.

constraint_handling.name: Geography accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Exact match of requested jurisdictions and geographic granularity against the question gold fields, with partial credit only for an explicitly scoped subset.

constraint_handling.name: Time accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Match requested start/end, cadence, and recency mode; penalize sources whose time boundary is overstated.

constraint_handling.name: Unit-of-analysis accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Match the predicted source grain to the required/forbidden unit fields.

constraint_handling.name: Access-filter accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Correctly include permitted access states and reject sources violating account/application/license/anonymous constraints.

constraint_handling.name: Authoritative-source accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Share of recommended sources satisfying the source-authority requirement and evidence-state rule.

constraint_handling.name: Format/interface accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Share of recommended sources whose observed interface/format is compatible with the requested alternatives.

constraint_handling.name: Negative-requirement accuracy
constraint_handling.formula: Share of explicitly excluded measures or source classes absent from the recommendation, with any mention labeled as a limitation/near miss.

bundle_quality.name: Required-role coverage
bundle_quality.formula: Required analytical roles present in the proposed bundle divided by gold required roles.

bundle_quality.name: Essential-component recall
bundle_quality.formula: Gold essential bundle components retrieved/recommended divided by all essential components.

bundle_quality.name: Unnecessary-source rate
bundle_quality.formula: Recommended sources not in the minimum bundle or optional enrichment set divided by all recommended sources.

bundle_quality.name: Incompatible-source rate
bundle_quality.formula: Recommended sources with a gold incompatible grain/time/geography/access condition divided by recommended sources.

bundle_quality.name: Unsupported-join rate
bundle_quality.formula: Proposed joins labeled join_proven without gold proof, or joins asserted as exact when gold status is candidate/crosswalk/unknown, divided by proposed joins.

explanation_and_trust.name: Evidence coverage
explanation_and_trust.formula: Claims with at least one exact evidence reference divided by all auditable source/constraint claims.

explanation_and_trust.name: Unsupported-claim rate
explanation_and_trust.formula: Claims contradicted by gold limitations or lacking evidence divided by audited claims.

explanation_and_trust.name: Access-state preservation
explanation_and_trust.formula: Recommended/mentioned source access states that exactly preserve the gold access state divided by all evaluated source mentions.

explanation_and_trust.name: Unknown preservation
explanation_and_trust.formula: Gold unknown/unresolved fields retained as unknown or explicitly unresolved divided by gold unknown/unresolved fields.

explanation_and_trust.name: Provenance accuracy
explanation_and_trust.formula: Evidence references that resolve to the cited existing project artifact/record divided by all evidence references.

explanation_and_trust.name: Limitation coverage
explanation_and_trust.formula: Gold material limitations surfaced in the plan divided by material limitations in the gold judgment/source record.

abstention.name: Clarification accuracy
abstention.formula: Clarification-required questions for which the system asks for all material missing dimensions before ranking divided by clarification questions.

abstention.name: Unsupported-question detection
abstention.formula: Unsupported/incomplete questions with explicit abstention divided by all unsupported/incomplete questions.

abstention.name: False no-result rate
abstention.formula: Supported questions incorrectly abstained from divided by supported questions.

abstention.name: Unjustified confident-answer rate
abstention.formula: Clarification/unsupported questions receiving a confident recommendation without the required clarification or gap statement divided by clarification/unsupported questions.

scoring_rules.abstention_is_not_a_zero_result: Score abstention against clarification/unsupported gold labels, not against retrieval recall.
